name: required_columns
detail: All required source fields must be present.

name: raw_row_count
detail: Supplied project extract is expected to contain 27,800 rows.

name: required_value_nulls
detail: Null cells across required source fields.

name: date_parsing
detail: Rows whose date could not be parsed.

name: calendar_date_coverage
detail: Missing dates are reported; they are not imputed.

name: multiple_snapshots_per_date
detail: Snapshot boundaries are inferred from source-order resets to position 1.

name: march_1_reconstruction
detail: The 100-row date must reconstruct as two complete Top-50 snapshots.

name: position_domain
detail: Positions must be integers from 1 to 50.

name: snapshot_row_counts
detail: Each valid snapshot must contain 50 rows.

name: duplicate_snapshot_positions
detail: Each expected position may occur once per snapshot.

name: missing_snapshot_positions
detail: Missing ranks within reconstructed snapshots.

name: exact_source_duplicates
detail: Repeated complete source rows are retained when they belong to different inferred snapshots.

name: duplicate_recordings_within_snapshot
detail: Repeated recording proxies inside one snapshot require review.

name: album_type_domain
detail: Unexpected release-format values.

name: explicit_content_domain
detail: Explicit flag must be boolean.

name: positive_duration
detail: Zero or negative duration values.

name: positive_total_tracks
detail: Invalid parent-release track counts.

name: popularity_bounds
detail: Popularity must be between 0 and 100.

name: artist_parsing
detail: Entries with no parsed credited artist.

name: empty_collaborator_arrays
detail: Chart entries without a credited-artist array.

name: nationality_coverage
detail: Manual nationality mapping is incomplete by design; unclassified artists remain explicit.

name: recording_metadata_stability
detail: Recording-proxy metadata can legitimately vary across repeated chart observations; the proxy identity remains title + exact duration.

name: title_collisions
detail: Normalised song titles associated with multiple exact durations.

name: fractional_artist_weights
detail: Fractional artist weights for each chart entry must reconcile to 1.0.

name: output_row_consistency
detail: Raw and processed row counts must reconcile; derived grains are reported separately.
